name: PosterSum
description: PosterSum is a multimodal benchmark for scientific poster summarization, containing 16,305 conference posters paired with their abstracts. It challenges vision-language models to understand complex layouts, dense text, tables, and figures to generate accurate textual summaries of scientific posters.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark from the paper introducing PosterSum, with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on summarization of visually complex scientific posters; proposes a hierarchical method improving ROUGE-L by 3.14% over current MLLMs.
